messages:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: SEV2 - unusual auth failures observed from edge-proxy cluster (edge-proxy-1..3). 401 spike: ~10k 401s in 2m from 3 CIDRs. Suspect leaked debug logs. Traces: https://observability.example/trace/3278901234

sam-sre: acked. i'm on call. gathering quick metrics and customer impact now. any signs of token reuse?

alice-ops: on it. can you post the top client IPs and any userids? i see a small head of requests from a cloud scraping range.

jordan-security: preliminary grep of recent log archive (last 8h) found a few lines with "auth_header: Bearer" in a staging debug dump that landed in an external indexer. possible partial tokens leaked. low confidence on full creds but treat as compromise until proven otherwise.

lisa-custsuccess: flagged possible customer impact to CS. do we have list of affected org ids? i'll prep a holding statement if needed.

sam-sre: top IPs: 52.146.12.3, 18.204.33.7, 34.120.9.88. Affected org_ids: org_102, org_731 (very small volume), most 401s are unauthenticated probe traffic. No successful token reuse observed yet.

alice-ops: immediate mitigation proposals: 1) add those IPs to blocklist at edge WAF, 2) rotate service account tokens used by the indexer path, 3) initiate KMS key rotation for temp staging logs bucket, 4) invalidate any short-lived tokens issued in past 12h for svc-indexer. agree?

jordan-security: +1. also create a granular audit timeline and snapshot the suspect logs for forensic preservation. we should sign an incident ticket and attach hashes.

ops-tooling-bot: ran rotation playbook  (playbook id pb-rotate-2026-07). Commands executed: `aws iam rotate-service-account --name svc-indexer --dry-run=false` `edge-waf block add --cidr 52.146.12.3/32 --reason "suspect-scrape-3278901234"`

alice-ops: executed quick block and kicked rotate for svc-indexer tokens. please confirm downstream consumers for svc-indexer (analytics pipeline, debug forwarder).

sam-sre: confirming: analytics-pipeline and log-forwarder are dependent. i've pushed a canary config to route traffic away from edge-proxy-2 while we scrub logs. also started a streaming ACL to catch further probe IPs.

jordan-security: will run a KMS key schedule and create a revocation list. also recommend we rotate any customer-facing webhook secrets that touched staging indexer in last 24h.

lisa-custsuccess: capturing current impact: only 2 small customers have any traces referencing leaking lines (org_102 and org_731). CS will prepare outreach if customers confirm any anomalies. please add me to the incident ticket.

alice-ops: action items updated in ticket INC-2026-327890: block IPs, rotate svc-indexer tokens, KMS rotate for s3-staging-logs, preserve log snapshots, CS standby. estimated containment in 20-45m.

sam-sre: monitoring: 401s down ~85% after WAF block, no new successful auth observed. keeping pager open until KMS rotation completes.

jordan-security: noted evidence preserved. I'll run a quick correlation to see if those IPs did any API calls that succeeded earlier.

lisa-custsuccess: thanks team. i'll ping you if customers ask. feel free to @channel if customer outreach required. :thumbsup:

alice-ops: closing loop for now. next updates in ticket and follow-up postmortem to capture root cause (debug log leak -> indexer misconfig).

pagerbot: incident severity -> SEV2 -> retained. oncall: sam-sre. handoff planned to next oncall in 3h if stable.
